target.projectDescription: copyparty 1.8.1 'argon' (copyparty/__version__.py VERSION = (1, 8, 1), CODENAME 'argon', BUILD_DT 2023-07-07) - a dependency-free multi-protocol file server (README: 'turn almost any device into a file server with resumable uploads/downloads using any web browser'; protocols http // ftp // webdav // smb/cifs). Path-traversal-relevant architecture, all verified in the shipped copyparty/ package (no web framework - hand-rolled socket-level HTTP stack): (1) the HTTP request path channel - httpcli.py:241 splits the raw request line into self.mode/self.req/self.http_ver from the socket; :329-:343 splits self.req into vpath + uparam (query values percent-decoded per-key at :341 via unquotep); vpath is dot-filtered FIRST (undot at :333/:337) and percent-decoded AFTER (self.vpath = unquotep(vpath) at :375 - encoded traversal such as %2e%2e therefore survives the first undot and the decoded '..' is only removed by the SECOND undot inside VFS.get at authsrv.py:473); :377-:383 rejects \x00 and (windows-only, relchk) illegal chars; :423-:428 resolves self.vpath through asrv.vfs.get() into a volume node + fs remainder and builds the absolute path via vn.canonical(rem) (authsrv.py:498-:504: realpath + '/' + rem, then absreal = abspath(realpath(...)) symlink resolution) with vn.chk_ap(ap) containment only when the volume opted into xdev/xvol flags (authsrv.py:705-:734 prefix-match aps.startswith(vap)); the resulting abspath reaches the file-serving read tx_file (httpcli.py:2597: bos.stat :2610, bos.open O_RDONLY :2615, dynamic open_func(*open_args) at :2772 with open_func = open at :2733, then sendfile_kern os.sendfile / sendfile_py f.read) at :3537, the static-resource read os.path.join(self.E.mod, 'web/', self.vpath[5:]) at :782 (vpath under .cpr), the browser listing (dcanonical at :3431, README open at :3604, ?doc= file read at :3871-:3874 with doc = unquotep(uparam doc) and os.path.join(abspath, doc) + open) and the thumbnail channel (thumbcli.get(dbv, vrem, ...) at :3506 -> th_srv.py:190-:197 abspath = os.path.join(ptop, rem) with NO undot/relchk/assert_safe_rem on this join, then Image.open(fsenc(abspath)) at th_srv.py:355); (2) the WebDAV write channel - handle_lock dcanonical+open(fsenc(abspath),'wb') at :1117/:1159, handle_move dst = self.headers['destination'] regex-stripped and unquotep-decoded at :1197-:1199 then _mv(self.vpath, dst...), MKCOL _mkdir (parser.require('name') :2049, sanitize_fn :2052, canonical :2059, bos.mkdir :2071), PUT dump_to_file (vfs.get :1389, canonical :1392, bos.makedirs :1403, ren_open atomic-create :1519/:1561 - the ren_open wrapper util.py:1173 resolves os.path.join(fdir, fname) and opens via the dynamic fun=open at :1216), new_md open(fsenc(fn),'wb') at :2110, and the up2k chunk/channel uploads - all write paths pass _assert_safe_rem (httpcli.py:197-:200: rejects rem starting '/' or '../' or containing '/../') at :2058/:2096/:2148/:2415, while the READ paths (tx_file/tx_browser/thumbnails/static) do NOT pass any such check; (3) the up2k upload engine (up2k.py) - the browser POSTs the handshake JSON parsed at httpcli.py:1752 json.loads (client fields name/hash/size/lmod; server injects ptop/vtop/prel from the vpath at :1769-:1774, name = undot(body['name']) + sanitize_fn(cj['name'], '', ...) at :1765 / up2k.py:2235 - basename-only since ok='' per util.py:1691); destinations are built with djoin(job['ptop'], job['prel'], job['name']) (up2k.py:2666/:2699/:2727-:2730, djoin = os.path.join minus empty args, util.py:1658) and written via ren_open/hashcopy; delete/remove goes through bos.unlink(djoin(ptop, rd, fn)) at up2k.py:2909/:2925 (rd/fn from the client JSON 'srch'/'delete' arrays, percent-decoded at httpcli.py:1726 before tx_zip/handle_rm - handle_rm at :3304 delegates to the up2k broker process via broker.ask('up2k.handle_rm', ...) :3319 - a cross-process boundary); (4) the zip/tar download channel - tx_zip (httpcli.py:2788) feeds vn.zipgen (authsrv.py:640, walk/statdir-based) into StreamZip/StreamTar (szip.py/star.py) whose gen reads each file via yieldfile (szip.py:259 -> util.py:2120-:2127 open(fsenc(fn), 'rb')); item names are unquotep-decoded at httpcli.py:1726; (5) the FTP channel - ftpd.py FtpFs (pyftpdlib subclass): v2a (:142-:176) backslash-normalizes, sanitize_fn-basenames the final component (:157), resolves vfs.get(vpath) (:160) + canonical (:166) and returns os.path.join(vfs.realpath, rem) (:176); rv2a joins the client-controlled CWD state (:188-:189, os.path.join(self.cwd, vpath)); FtpFs.open/mkdir/rmdir/remove/rename/stat (:205/:250/:288/:296/:306/:323) all funnel through v2a/rv2a with open(fsenc(ap), mode) at :221; validpath (:198) only guards /.hist/ internals; (6) the SMB channel - smbd.py _v2a (:122-:131) resolves vfs.get(vpath, LEELOO_DALLAS, True, True) + canonical(rem) and _open (:163-:185) calls bos.open(ap, flags) at :185; (7) the deployer/CLI environment - __main__.py os.environ.get('XDG_CONFIG_HOME'/'TMPDIR'/'TEMP'/'TMP'/'APPDATA'/'TERM') at :148-:152/:202/:1148 (operator trust level). Filesystem access is centralized in the first-party bos module (copyparty/bos/: bos.open/stat/unlink/rename/mkdir/makedirs wrap os with windows long-path handling; bos.path.* wraps os.path) - a first-party fs abstraction, in scope.

Per WORKFLOW.md 4.2.3 the no-framework path applies: source/sink shapes were derived from repository code using references/python.md (HTTP request path/query/body/header values, handler parameters, file APIs open/Path/os.path/shutil, archive extraction destination handling) and references/patterns.md; no framework reference file was loaded because none matches (django.md/flask.md/fastapi.md exist in the Augur installation but their detection heuristics - django.urls, @app.route, fastapi imports - all fail against this codebase). inputBoundaryInventory.summary: copyparty is a framework-less multi-protocol file server, so every untrusted-input boundary is first-party code: (1) the HTTP request line self.req (raw path+query from the socket, httpcli.py:241), the decoded URL path self.vpath (unquotep at :375, dot-filtered before decode) and the percent-decoded query dict self.uparam (per-key unquotep at :341) - self.vpath is the single most load-bearing attacker-controlled value in the server (116 references in httpcli.py); (2) HTTP headers self.headers (40 read sites, including the WebDAV Destination header that becomes a move target at :1197-:1199) and cookies self.cookies; (3) the URL-decoder family itself - unquotep/unquote call sites (:341, :375, :1199, :1327, :1726, :3337, :3871) covering the post-decode values for zip item lists, delete/move targets and the ?doc= file read; (4) the up2k handshake JSON body (json.loads at :1752; client fields name/size/lmod/hash, delete/srch item arrays) and multipart form fields + filenames (self.parser.require / self.parser.gen - the MultipartParser at util.py:1268 reads from the request socket, filename later basenamed by sanitize_fn); (5) FTP: the vpath parameters of FtpFs.v2a/rv2a plus the client-controlled CWD state self.cwd (ftpd.py:188); (6) SMB: the vpath parameters of smbd.py _v2a/_open/_listdir; (7) environment variables in __main__.py (deployer trust level). The sink side funnels through builtin open() and the first-party bos module (bos.open/stat/unlink/rename/mkdir/makedirs, bos.path.*), os.sendfile/os.scandir/os.unlink, PIL Image.open, the ren_open/yieldfile/statdir/sendfile_kern/sendfile_py util wrappers, the VFS path-resolution core (vfs.get / canonical / dcanonical / chk_ap) and the os.path join/check/resolve propagation pipeline.

guardsAndEvidence.guard: double-undot with decode in between (ordering hazard, the core CWE-022 evidence)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: httpcli.py:329-:337 applies undot (util.py:1673-:1686: drops '', '.' and '..' path segments) to the RAW (still percent-encoded) request path, THEN percent-decodes at :375 (self.vpath = unquotep(vpath)); VFS.get re-applies undot to the decoded value at authsrv.py:473. Consequences: (a) encoded traversal (%2e%2e%2f) survives the first undot and only the second undot inside vfs.get neutralizes the decoded '..' - the guard exists but its correctness depends on this double application being reachable on every path; (b) undot splits on '/' only, so backslash traversal ('..\\') passes undot on POSIX and is only stopped by the Windows-only relchk (httpcli.py:378-:380, authsrv.py:466-:471); (c) undot on the query-free branch only removes leading/duplicated dots - absolute-looking paths become relative ('/etc/x' -> 'etc/x') which is then joined onto the volume realpath.

httpcli.py:197-:200 raises on rem starting with '/' or '../' or containing '/../' ('sanity check to prevent any disasters'); applied ONLY to the write paths: _mkdir :2058, handle_new_md :2096, handle_plain_upload :2148, handle_text_upload :2415. The read paths (tx_file :3537, tx_browser :3431, static :782, thumbnails :3506, ?doc= :3874, zipgen) do NOT pass through any _assert_safe_rem - they rely solely on the vfs.get double-undot + canonical resolution. Also note '..' without a trailing component ('a/..') and mid-path 'x..y' are not covered by the check (only '../' patterns).

authsrv.py:498-:504: canonical(rem) = realpath + '/' + rem then absreal (util.py:1733-:1743: os.path.abspath(os.path.realpath(...))) when resolve=True - symlinks under the volume are resolved at request time, so a symlink planted between resolution and the later open/stat (tx_file :2610 stat then :2772 open; th_srv worker :223 queue then :355 Image.open) is a classic TOCTOU window; dcanonical (:506-:513) resolves only the parent directory, leaving the final component un-resolved at open time.

guardsAndEvidence.guard: chk_ap prefix containment is opt-in per volume (xdev/xvol flags)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: authsrv.py:705-:734: chk_ap validates aps.startswith(vap) (prefix match, no separator-boundary check documented) and device-id equality - but ONLY for volumes configured with the xdev or xvol flags (httpcli.py:424-:428). Default volumes have no post-canonical containment at all; the string-concatenation ap = self.realpath + '/' + rem at :500-:502 plus the undot chain is the entire defense.

util.py:1689-:1718: sanitize_fn(fn, ok, bad) with ok='' takes fn.replace('\\','/').split('/')[-1] (basename-only) plus windows devname/charset remapping; applied to the multipart upload filename (httpcli.py:2176-:2178, up2k.py:2235), the FTP final path component (ftpd.py:157) and the mkdir/new-md form names (httpcli.py:2052/:2101). NOT applied to URL-path components (the vpath channel) and NOT to the up2k 'prel' relative directory (server-derived at httpcli.py:1774) or the delete/srch/move item arrays (unquotep at :1726/:3337, resolved through vfs.get/undot like the read path).

httpcli.py:377-:383 rejects \x00 in self.vpath always and applies relchk (util.py:1721-:1730: windows illegal chars [\\:*?"<>|] and CRLF) only under ANYWIN; authsrv.py:466-:471 applies relchk inside vfs.get under ANYWIN. On POSIX, backslashes and control chars other than \x00 pass into canonical's string concatenation.

authsrv.py:476-:486 checks uread/uwrite/umove/udel per volume; httpcli.py:399-:406 resolves the user from pw/headers/cookies/basic-auth. Auth limits WHO can request a path, not WHAT path is resolved - and the FTP v2a path additionally funnels through vfs.get with the user's permissions, while smbd.py:130 resolves with LEELOO_DALLAS (the full-access builtin account) - SMB paths bypass the per-user volume permission check by design. opt-in per-volume filekey (fk) checks exist at httpcli.py:3517-:3524 for get-only volumes.
ftpd.py:198-:203 blocks '/.hist/' internals (up2k.* and dir.txt) on the FTP channel only; the HTTP side implements the same guard ad-hoc at httpcli.py:3453-:3456 for the browser listing path.

Non-matching same-named locals would survive to labeling as noise.
